personality_one_liner: Cinematic, expensive, and dark negative space with a focus on immersive media consumption.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing. Empty space is intentional. Use xl/2xl for main section gaps.

do's: Use glass/blur for the Activation card over the cinematic background.
Use glass for the top header / search bar over scrolling EPG/channel content.
Use glass for the video player controls overlay.
Pair blur with a translucent tinted base (≥75% of surface) underneath for readability.
dont's: Do not apply glass to body text regions or form fields.
Do not use generic shadows; rely entirely on blur and translucent layering.

screens.name: Activation
screens.purpose: Minimalist ten-foot UI display for initial device linking.

states.loading: Subtle pulse on the status text

screens.layout: Full-bleed cinematic background image with a top-to-bottom dark gradient scrim. A centered, frosted glass card displaying ONLY the MAC Address (large mono-spaced feel), PIN (Senha), and a status indicator (Aguardando...). NO BUTTONS. The screen must auto-poll/mock a transition to the next screen upon activation.

screens.name: ChannelBrowser
screens.purpose: Discovery interface for live TV and VOD content with immediate visual hierarchy.

states.empty: Glassy empty state with a subtle branded illustration
states.error: Glass modal over the list with a retry button

screens.layout: Glassy sticky header containing Search and a horizontal row of 4 pills ('TV Ao Vivo', 'Filmes', 'Séries', 'Músicas'). Below is a rich 2-column or list layout of channels/content cards. Cards use 'surfaceSecondary' with actual channel logos or movie posters. A gradient-to-dark scrim MUST sit between any image and its text.

screens.name: VideoPlayer
screens.purpose: Immersive, full-screen playback with distraction-free overlay controls.

states.loading: Centered spinner over pure black background
states.error: Error message with a primary 'Retry' action over pure black

screens.layout: Pure black screen surface. Video plays in the background. A bottom glassmorphism overlay houses the Play/Pause, Next/Prev channel controls. Controls should auto-hide. Include an explicit error state with a retry button to meet requirements.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the '6 Glass / Luxe' personality. Relies heavily on cinematic depth, dark negative space, and frosted glass overlays (expo-blur) rather than heavy drop shadows.

CRITICAL: The Activation screen MUST NOT contain any interactive buttons. Display the MAC, Senha, and a Status Badge. Mock an automatic polling sequence (e.g., setTimeout) that transitions from 'Aguardando' to 'Ativa' and navigates to the ChannelBrowser.

For the ChannelBrowser, implement a sticky top glass header for search and the 4 category chips (TV Ao Vivo, Filmes, Séries, Músicas). Use the provided HBO logo and Sci-Fi poster images for list items.
Zero tolerance for rendering text directly on images without a scrim. Always use a top-to-bottom expo-linear-gradient (transparent to >=75% surfaceInverse/black) behind text that sits over images.

Build the VideoPlayer as a full-screen view (pure black background) with a translucent glass overlay at the bottom for controls (Play/Pause, Next/Prev). Ensure loading and error (with retry button) states fill the flex container.
Ensure 'Fraunces' is used for display/hero headings and 'Satoshi' for body text to maintain the premium cinematic feel.
